_comment: Bone map for the heroine rig (from juniper/BONEMAP.md). Every rig-specific fact the pipeline needs lives here; the code is model-agnostic. Axes are given in glTF space (Y up). The rig faces +Z in glTF space (= -Y in Blender) so +X is her left; the CMU BVH actor also faces +Z with +X on his left, so no mirroring is needed.

target._ground_y: null = derive from the lowest mesh vertex of the rig GLB (rest pose); set a number to override

_align: relative = transfer the source bone's rotation change from its own rest pose (both rest poses must be the same pose for that bone: trunk, head, feet). direction = make the target bone point where the source bone points (needed where the mocap rest pose is not a real pose: the CMU rest splays the thighs 20 degrees and holds the arms dead level while this rig droops them 15 degrees).

tuning._stance_widen: Each ankle is moved outwards by this fraction of a leg length: the actor walks a narrow line and this rig's boots are bulky, so an exact transfer crosses the feet.
tuning._by_kind: Per-gait overrides of any tuning knob (applied after the clip is classified walk / run).
tuning._accessory: Baked in-cycle follow-through for the accessory chains: spring frequency (Hz), damping ratio and swing limit per chain name (or default). The solve runs to a periodic steady state; a chain that drifts more than seam_tol leg-lengths between its last two passes fails the clip. Root-driven lag (starts, stops, turns) is the player's job - see player/secondary.js.
tuning._primary_clips: Listed first in the manifest; the player takes the first clip of each kind.
tuning._gains: trunk_gain scales the counter-rotation of the spine chain against the pelvis about its cycle mean; pelvis_gain does the same for the pelvis itself. hip_drop lowers the pelvis by this fraction of a leg length so the stance leg never has to lock straight.
tuning._arm_swing_gain: Multiplies the fore/aft swing of each whole arm about the shoulder (measured in the torso frame, about the per-clip mean). 1.0 = exactly the actor. A modest gain makes the swing read past the capelet that hides the shoulders.
tuning._contact: Foot-contact detection: a heel/toe point counts as planted when it is within contact_height_tol * leg_length of the ground and its horizontal speed in travel space is below contact_speed_tol * leg_length per second.
tuning._quality: Clips fail when planted-foot skate exceeds foot_skate_max_ratio * ground_speed (or foot_skate_max_abs leg-lengths/s when the clip is near-stationary), when a foot point sinks below -penetration_tol * leg_length, or when a knee bends backwards by more than knee_flip_tol_deg.
tuning._kind: Ground speed in source leg-lengths per second: above kind_run_speed = run, below kind_idle_speed = idle, otherwise walk.

accessory_chains._comment: For the secondary-motion milestone (player side, not baked by this pipeline).
